h13.

**impl** — A single concrete implementation, the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:57-60` (holds a `goldmark.Markdown`). It implements the `markdown.Service` interface (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`) and is the only implementation — the same concrete type runs in both production and tests (no fake/no-op variant exists).

**construction** — Built by the factory `markdown.NewService(...)` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:84-113`), which returns `&service{md: goldmark.New(...)}`. In production it is constructed exactly once, inside `NewAPIV1Service` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`, wired with `WithTagExtension()` + `WithMentionExtension()`, and stored on `APIV1Service.MarkdownService`. That one instance is then shared/passed to the other holders (e.g. `server/server.go:85` hands `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` to the RSS service). Tests construct their own via `NewService(...)` in `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427`, and `server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54`.

**holders** — Components that depend on the `markdown.Service` interface (as a field/parameter):
- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` (used in `memo_service.go:108,447`, `memo_mention_helpers.go:32`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:85`).
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, injected via `NewRunner(...)` (line 19) and also passed as a parameter to the free function `RebuildMemoPayload(...)` (line 74).
- `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected via `NewRSSService(...)` (line 58), used in `RenderHTML` at line 339.

(Note: this is the backend abstraction. The frontend renders markdown with markdown-it in `web/src/components/MemoContent/MemoMarkdownRenderer.tsx`, but that path is not placed behind an interface — the interface in question is the Go `markdown.Service`.)

```go
type Service interface {
    ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)
    ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error)
    ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error)
    RenderMarkdown(content []byte) (string, error)
    RenderHTML(content []byte) (string, error)
    GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)
    ValidateContent(content []byte) error
    RenameTag(content []byte, oldTag, newTag string) (string, error)
}
```

This is the backend abstraction. It wraps the `goldmark` library and handles metadata extraction (tags, mentions, properties), snippet generation, validation, tag renaming, and HTML/markdown rendering.

### 2. Concrete implementation(s) that execute at runtime

There is exactly **one** concrete implementation:

- **`service` struct** in **`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`** (lines 57–113). It holds a `goldmark.Markdown` (`md` field) and implements all eight interface methods (lines 143–453). Created via `NewService(opts ...Option) Service` (line 85), which returns `&service{md: md}`.

There is **no** mock/fake/no-op implementation anywhere in the codebase — I searched for mock/fake/stub/noop implementations and found none. Tests use the real `markdown.NewService(...)` as well, so the same concrete `service` executes at runtime and in tests.

A related helper type, **`MarkdownRenderer`** in **`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go`** (struct at line 15, `NewMarkdownRenderer()` at line 20), is a plain struct (not an interface implementation). It is used internally by `service.RenderMarkdown` and `service.RenameTag` (markdown.go lines 250 and 451) to render the goldmark AST back to markdown text. Custom goldmark extensions live in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/extensions/` (`tag.go`, `mention.go`), with AST nodes in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/ast/` and parsers in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/parser/`.

### 3. Who constructs / instantiates it (wiring)

The interface is constructed via `markdown.NewService(...)` at these sites:

- **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go`** line 48–51 — the **primary runtime wiring**. `NewAPIV1Service(...)` builds it with `markdown.WithTagExtension()` and `markdown.WithMentionExtension()` and stores it in the `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` field (line 56). This is the single instance that flows through the whole server.
- **`/bench/repo/server/server.go`** line 85 — reuses `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` to build the RSS service (`rss.NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store, apiV1Service.MarkdownService)`). It does not create a new one; it passes the same instance.
- **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go`** lines 44–52 — test wiring, constructs a real service with the same options.
- **`/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss_test.go`** line 54 and **`/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go`** line 427 — test-only constructions with `markdown.NewService(...)`.

The wiring is manual constructor-injection (no DI framework, no factory beyond `NewService`).
